title: Second Lessons: Ember
introNarration: Cinder taps the Primer. Soot has dried on her whiskers. The grate still holds a low, useful fire. "Cast ember at the hearth dummy in this room. Then talk to me. After that, the Primer will hold one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."
reminderNarration: Cast ember at the hearth dummy in this hearth, then talk to Cinder. Name the fire before you feed it.
completionNarration: The second hearth lesson is done. The Primer lies open on the grate-side table, smelling of smoke and ink. Open the Primer and type ink and the vein's name.
